title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you average predictions from multiple models, how does it affect the bias and variance of the ensemble model compared to a single model?

title: Effect on Bias
text: Averaging predictions from multiple models tends to reduce the bias of the ensemble model. This is because the ensemble can capture more patterns from the data than a single model.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Averaging predictions from multiple models generally reduces the variance of the ensemble model. This is because the errors from individual models tend to cancel each other out.
